crossRefs.note: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong…
For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered…
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand…
for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps…
For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
“He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their…
saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see…
For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they…
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains…
Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give…
Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much…
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in…
Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and…
Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

translations.web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.
translations.bsb: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
translations.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
translations.asv: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.
